ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Via Notepad++ Plugins
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of new ".dll" files inside the plugins directory of a notepad++ installation by a process other than "gup.exe". Which could indicates possible persistence

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Notepad\\+\\+\\\\plugins\\\\.*") AND file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\Notepad\\+\\+\\\\updater\\\\gup\\\.exe$") OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Users\\\\") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\target\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("Installer\\\.x64\\\.exe$"))) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\npp\\\..*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\.exe$") AND (file_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Notepad\+\+\\plugins\\NppExport\\NppExport\.dll" OR file_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Notepad\+\+\\plugins\\mimeTools\\mimeTools\.dll" OR file_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Notepad\+\+\\plugins\\NppConverter\\NppConverter\.dll" OR file_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Notepad\+\+\\plugins\\Config\\nppPluginList\.dll")))
